effectivePrompt.uiUxIntent: RCA follow-up run for the Adobe small-business thank-you benchmark using a concrete flat-stationery prompt that bans people/faces/portraits.
effectivePrompt.benchmarkScope: front-panel-only image generation to control cost
effectivePrompt.frontImagePrompt: Premium 5x7 portrait greeting card front design, flat stationery artwork only. No people, no faces, no bodies, no hands, no portraits. Warm cream paper background with citrus, soft gold, and deep teal accents. Elegant small-business thank-you card with a subtle illustrated boutique storefront awning, kraft shopping bag, tissue paper, ribbon, small blank gift tag, botanical sprig, and handmade local-shop texture. Leave a clean open safe area in the lower third for app-added typography. High-end print-ready stationery composition, minimal clutter, generous margins, soft natural light, refined editorial product-card style. No readable text, no logo, no watermark, no QR code, no folded-card mockup, no collage, no table scene, no crop marks.

memory_citations: The customer chose an independent small business instead of a large marketplace.
The owner wants the message to feel handmade, specific, and grateful rather than promotional.
CustomCard UX requires four editable panels, print-safe margins, human review before external sharing, and exportable/persisted render artifacts.
